thread:
ana (Partnerships): Heads-up: CloudScale + KernelWorks propose a partner-managed AP-south2 region for Redwood Dedicated. They want marketplace listing, reserved capacity (initial), and our certification checklist completed. timeline: ~6 weeks. Who owns quota/KMS/testing?

jordan (Cloud): I'll take quota + KMS. Need exact SKUs and expected traffic pattern. Any burst requirements?

sam (EngInfra): For low-latency SLAs we'll require SR-IOV NICs and NVMe local disks. Suggest node profile: 24GB GPU, 12vCPU host, 1TB NVMe. We'll run perf harness in partner staging.

maria (Product): KernelWorks asks for p99 <= 120ms for 1k-token baseline. Can we validate that in partner infra?

sam (EngInfra): Yes, but need staging creds + network access. Plan: KV-cache warm + 6h continuous run + failover test across two nodepools.

tom (Ops): Marketplace metadata needed: region id, SKUs, pricing tiers, SLA text, KMS modes. I'll draft wire copy.

lee (Legal): We'll need a DPA and KMS key authority clause; also incident notif windows (30min Sev1). I can draft SOW addendum in 3 business days.

ana (Partnerships): KernelWorks sent SKU mapping: gpu=cloudscale-a100s, cpu=n2-standard-16, disk=1TB NVMe, network=25Gb SR-IOV. Compatible?

sam (EngInfra): cloudscale-a100s maps to our 40GB GPU profile; compatible. Recommend 80GB variant for long-context jobs.

jordan (Cloud): Partner requests initial 50 GPUs with burst to 100. I'll file quota request today (ref CS-AP-4321).

sam (EngInfra): Split across pool-A(25) and pool-B(25) for failover. OK for perf.

maria (Product): Marketing wants a co-branded one-pager but will hold public announcement until perf and legal pass. Target week 6.

ana (Partnerships): Please add ETAs here so I can sync with partner on Monday.

sam (EngInfra): Perf harness starts Tue 09:00 PT, initial p99 by Wed EOD. Full 6h stability Thu morning.

jordan (Cloud): Quota request submitted; ETA 48-72h. KMS flow doc uploaded.

lee (Legal): DPA + KMS clause draft by Thu EOD.

tom (Ops): Marketplace draft by Wed AM.

maria (Product): Co-brand draft by Thu, awaiting perf green.

deploy-bot: [job] perf-harness/789 queued by sam; logs will post here.

ana (Partnerships): Thanks all. I'll coordinate kickoff after quota ack and share tracker.
